51217340.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human GKRP by surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using human GKRP (hGKRP) immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip (GE Healthcare) via amine coupling. The immobilization level was approximately 1000 response units (RU). The running buffer was HBS-EP+ (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4). Compounds were diluted in running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. Association and dissociation phases were 120 and 180 seconds, respectively. Regeneration was achieved with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0) for 30 seconds. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare) with a 1:1 Langmuir binding model. The dissociation constant (Kd) was calculated as the ratio of the dissociation rate constant (kd) to the association rate constant (ka).

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: HBS-EP+ (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4)
